name: Einstein’s special relativity
summary: Einstein's 1905 theory took the laws of physics and the speed of light to be the same for all steadily moving observers, reshaping ideas of space and time.
description: Relativity of inertial frames and invariant light speed lead to a consistent spacetime treatment of moving bodies and electrodynamics.
tier_reason: The framework underlies subsequent particle physics, relativistic dynamics and precision physical modelling across generations.
why: Maxwell's electrodynamics and Newtonian mechanics treated motion inconsistently, and attempts to detect motion through the ether had failed.
